scope: Qualification-only complete local COR/DST/GLOB selection stages and original transitive intersection helpers. Stage wrappers and typed ABI are separately reviewed.

retained_abi.scope: one supplied local retained occurrence; MVSIZ=1
retained_abi.coordinates: real(c_double)(3,5): four main corners then secondary
retained_abi.scalars: real(c_double)(12): main K, secondary K, secondary gap, main gap max, four vertex gaps, DRAD, DGAPLOAD, two selection metrics
retained_abi.flags: integer(c_int)(19): four equality-preserving node indices, four neighbors, four boundary references, ETYP, global main ID, four IRTLM values, ICONT_I
retained_abi.values: real(c_double)(9,4): raw LB/LC, clamped LB/LC, PENT, cache PENM/LBM/LCM, observed DD
retained_abi.sector_flags: integer(c_int)(4,4): FAR, cached FAR, raw-defined, clamped-defined
retained_abi.row_values: real(c_double)(4): classification product, DIST, two selection metrics
retained_abi.defined: integer(c_int): wrapper old-sector-readiness only; not a native status

continuation_abi.scope: one supplied local occurrence and row snapshot; MVSIZ=1; serial qualification
continuation_abi.common_arrays: same coordinates(3,5), scalars(12), normals(3,4), flags(19), and finite seed as retained
continuation_abi.references: integer(c_int) raw ADMSR(4), ISLIDE(4), LBOUND(reference_count); references not compressed
continuation_abi.bisectors: real(c_float)(3,2,reference_count), direct native indices, qualification cap1048576
continuation_abi.segment_count: actual native NRTM, scalar integer(c_int) by reference
continuation_abi.constraints: integer(c_int)(5) main1..4 then secondary, separately for ICODT and ISKEW
continuation_abi.sector_flags: integer(c_int)(6,4): FAR, cached FAR, raw-defined, clamped-defined, KSLIDE, INGAP
continuation_abi.row_markers: integer(c_int)(4), source IRTLM; C++ restores local_main only after an observed winner write
continuation_abi.row_values: real(c_double)(4): classification product, DIST, two selection metrics
continuation_abi.decision: integer(c_int)(2), observed effective IT and local winner-branch entry; inactive selected IT is API-zero

new_impact_abi.scope: one supplied local occurrence, actual indexed main/reference tables, serial reference-only COMMON
new_impact_abi.counts: integer(c_int)(4): NRTM, reference slots, primary local main, ICONT_I
new_impact_abi.kinematics: real(c_double)(3,5,2): four primary corners then secondary, position then velocity
new_impact_abi.source_int: integer(c_int)(14,NRTM): IRECT4, MSEGTYP, MSEGLO, MVOISIN4, ADMSR4
new_impact_abi.control: real(c_double)(3): secondary coefficient, secondary gap, DT1
new_impact_abi.prior: IRTLM integer4 and selection metrics real2
new_impact_abi.row_outputs: IRTLM integer4 and selection metrics real2
